# UVI parity ledger

Generated by `cargo run -p sampler-uvi --example parity_summary -- --ledger` from `sampler_uvi::parity::ledger::entries()`. Do not edit rows by hand.

Statuses describe host bindings, not a claim of measured native DSP equivalence. Conditional writes are downgraded to Stub in a report when no concrete DSP binding exists. The older Falcon module coverage document supplies the catalog/spec inventory, not current implementation verdicts.

Runtime inspection: `ScriptHost::new_inspected` compiles Luau with real statement-line coverage (level 1). Ordinary constructors compile without coverage instructions or retained coverage functions. Inspection lasts for that host lifetime; create an ordinary host to turn it off. `coverage()` returns cumulative snapshots keyed by script id and line-start byte offsets. Luau counters saturate at their VM instruction limit; faults retain at most 256 messages of 1024 characters per script.

Reports: `sampler_uvi::parity_reports(&xml)` (valid loaded program XML), `parity::bank_reports(&bank, program_path)` and `Translated::parity_reports()`. Required embedded modules are included by the bank/translated entry points. Reports never hold source text or literal argument values.

Static resolution covers literal element collections, parent links, findLayer and straight-line aliases. Dynamic indices, control flow and computed parameter names remain explicitly unresolved. A lowering describes the binding, not proof that the call executed; real hits live in Coverage.
